title: A Simple Baseline for Streaming Video Understanding
task: Streaming video understanding with efficient context usage
key_results: SimpleStream with 4 recent frames achieves 67.7% on OVO-Bench and 80.59% on StreamingBench, matching or exceeding complex memory-based approaches
comments: The finding challenges the assumption that more context always improves performance; reveals an important perception-memory trade-off that should inform future benchmark design.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complex memory mechanisms are necessary for strong streaming video understanding
hypotheses.result: Refuted: simple sliding-window baseline matches published methods

hypotheses.hypothesis: Value of longer context increases uniformly with model scale
hypotheses.result: Refuted: context benefit is backbone-dependent

title: Agentic-MME: What Agentic Capability Really Brings to Multimodal Intelligence?
task: Evaluating multimodal agentic capabilities with process-level verification
key_results: Best model (Gemini3-pro) achieves 56.3% overall accuracy, dropping to 23.0% on Level-3 tasks; benchmark contains 418 tasks with 2,000+ stepwise checkpoints
comments: Process-verified evaluation with fine-grained intermediate states is more rigorous than answer-only metrics and reveals significant performance gaps on realistic problems.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Current MLLMs can effectively integrate visual and knowledge tools for real-world tasks
hypotheses.result: Partially unsupported: only 56.3% overall, 23% on hardest tasks

title: Token Warping Helps MLLMs Look from Nearby Viewpoints
task: Viewpoint change robustness in multimodal models via token warping
key_results: Token-level backward warping consistently outperforms pixel-wise warping, fine-tuned models, and generative approaches on ViewBench
comments: Applying geometric transformations at token level rather than pixel level is elegant and grounded in cognitive theory of mental imagery.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Token-level warping provides better geometric stability for viewpoint changes than pixel-wise warping
hypotheses.result: Supported: backward token warping outperforms all baselines

title: Self-Distilled RLVR
task: Improving LLM training stability by combining self-distillation with reinforcement learning
key_results: RLSD achieves higher convergence ceiling and superior training stability compared to pure RLVR or on-policy self-distillation
comments: The insight that privileged information causes information leakage is important; hybrid approach using self-distillation only for fine-grained magnitudes while RLVR provides directions is pragmatic.

hypotheses.hypothesis: On-policy self-distillation alone provides stable learning signals for LLMs
hypotheses.result: Refuted: causes information leakage and instability

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combining self-distillation for magnitudes with RLVR for directions improves training
hypotheses.result: Supported: achieves better convergence and stability

title: InCoder-32B-Thinking: Industrial Code World Model for Thinking
task: Code reasoning for industrial software with hardware-aware world modeling
key_results: 81.3% on LiveCodeBench v5, 84.0% on CAD-Coder, 38.0% on KernelBench; top-tier open-source performance across domains
comments: Domain-specific world model trained on execution traces is novel; validation through actual toolchains ensures reasoning traces match real problem-solving depth.

model_io.model: InCoder-32B with Error-driven Chain-of-Thought + Industrial Code World Model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Industrial code reasoning requires domain-specific world models beyond general LLM pretraining
hypotheses.result: Supported: ICWM enables self-verification and domain-specific benchmarks

title: AgentHazard: A Benchmark for Evaluating Harmful Behavior in Computer-Use Agents
task: Evaluating safety of computer-use agents against accumulated harmful behavior
key_results: Claude Code with Qwen3-Coder exhibits 73.63% attack success rate; benchmark contains 2,653 instances with locally legitimate but jointly unsafe sequences
comments: Key insight is that intermediate steps can be individually benign yet collectively lead to harm—a failure mode distinct from single-turn safety vulnerabilities.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model alignment alone ensures safety of autonomous computer-use agents
hypotheses.result: Refuted: 73.63% attack success rate indicates alignment insufficient

title: Xpertbench: Expert Level Tasks with Rubrics-Based Evaluation
task: Evaluating expert-level reasoning across professional domains with rubric-based assessment
key_results: Peak success rate ~66% across leading models; mean score ~55%; significant drop in performance on open-ended tasks despite closure on standard benchmarks
comments: ShotJudge with expert few-shot exemplars is a clever mitigation for self-reward bias; the expert-gap finding is significant for understanding current AI limitations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Current LLMs achieve strong performance on expert-level professional tasks
hypotheses.result: Refuted: peak 66% success, 55% mean indicates significant expert-gap

title: CoME-VL: Scaling Complementary Multi-Encoder Vision-Language Learning
task: Scaling complementary multi-encoder fusion for vision-language understanding
key_results: Average improvement of 4.9% on visual understanding and 5.4% on grounding tasks; state-of-the-art on RefCOCO detection
comments: Fusion of contrastive (CLIP) and self-supervised (DINO) encoders is well-motivated; entropy-guided aggregation with orthogonality constraints elegantly reduces redundancy.

model_io.model: CoME-VL (fusion of CLIP encoder + DINO encoder)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single contrastive vision encoder is optimal for vision-language modeling
hypotheses.result: Refuted: complementary multi-encoder fusion achieves consistent improvements

title: AgentSocialBench: Evaluating Privacy Risks in Human-Centered Agentic Social Networks
task: Evaluating privacy risks in human-centered agentic social networks
key_results: Privacy risks fundamentally harder than single-agent settings; abstraction paradox: privacy instructions increase sensitive information discussion; leakage persists despite explicit protection instructions
comments: The abstraction paradox is particularly concerning—agents taught to abstract actually discuss sensitive info more—suggesting counterintuitive failure modes in multi-agent coordination.

model_io.model: Multi-agent LLM systems with social network structure

hypotheses.hypothesis: Privacy preservation in multi-agent social networks follows similar principles as single-agent privacy
hypotheses.result: Refuted: cross-domain/cross-user coordination creates persistent leakage pressure

hypotheses.hypothesis: Teaching agents to abstract sensitive information improves privacy
hypotheses.result: Refuted: abstraction paradox shows this paradoxically increases discussion

title: OGT mediates O-GlcNAcylation of MEIS2 and affects palatal osteogenic development
task: Determine OGT-mediated O-GlcNAcylation of MEIS2 role in palatal bone development and cleft palate prevention
key_results: atRA-induced cleft palate models show declined O-GlcNAc levels; OGT loss in zebrafish increases cleft palate prevalence; MEIS2 Ser237 O-GlcNAcylation maintains protein stability by inhibiting ubiquitination; O-GlcNAcylation loss compromises palatal bone formation
comments: Post-translational modification of MEIS2 represents novel regulatory mechanism in osteogenic development with diagnostic/therapeutic potential, though in vivo MEIS2 Ser237 mutation validation in mammals awaits.

hypotheses.hypothesis: OGT-mediated MEIS2 O-GlcNAcylation at Ser237 maintains osteogenic homeostasis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; O-GlcNAcylation protects MEIS2 from ubiquitin-mediated degradation

title: Cochlear nucleus spatial transcriptomes of normal and hearing loss mice reveal a critical role of Spp1 in bushy cells
task: Generate cochlear nucleus cell atlas and identify Spp1-expressing bushy cells as critical for hearing loss-induced expression changes
key_results: Single-nucleus RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics reveal CN cell types, developmental gene expression changes, and hearing loss-induced alterations; Spp1-expressing bushy cells exhibit primary expression remodeling; Spp1 deletion impairs CN auditory signal processing
comments: Comprehensive cellular database enables systems-level understanding of auditory processing, though functional validation of other hearing loss-affected genes in bushy cells remains incomplete.

model_io.model: Single-nucleus RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics of mouse cochlear nucleus

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spp1-expressing bushy cells are primary CN cell type responsive to hearing loss
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Spp1 deletion impairs auditory processing

title: Non-necroptotic MLKL function damages mitochondria and promotes hematopoietic stem cell aging
task: Identify necroptosis-independent MLKL role in hematopoietic stem cell aging through mitochondrial damage
key_results: MLKL activates via RIPK3 axis under inflammation and replication stress, accumulates in HSC mitochondria, impairs self-renewal and lymphoid differentiation without causing cell death; mediates age-related mitochondrial damage and reduced glycolytic flux
comments: Necroptosis-independent MLKL function in HSC aging provides mechanistic link between stress response and hematopoietic decline, with potential therapeutic implications via RIPK3-MLKL inhibition.

model_io.model: Hematopoietic stem cells in aging mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: RIPK3-MLKL axis mediates age-related HSC functional decline via mitochondrial damage
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; independent of necroptotic cell death

title: Comprehensive CRISPR/Cas9-based mutagenesis identifies single-amino acid substitutions that abrogate SPEN function in X inactivation
task: Develop base editing screen to map sequence-function relationships and identify critical residues for SPEN function in X inactivation
key_results: CRISPR/Cas9-mediated base editing screen identified SPEN RRM4 residue W522 substitution that abrogates X-linked gene repression and impairs H3K27me3 deposition; haploid screening efficiently detects recessive mutations
comments: Systematic point mutagenesis in haploid cells enables discovery of residues invisible in diploid screens, though functional validation of W522 role in Xist RNA binding awaits direct biochemical analysis.

model_io.model: CRISPR/Cas9 base editing screen in mouse embryonic stem cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: SPEN RRM4 region contains residues critical for Xist-mediated repression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; W522 substitution abrogates function

title: VPS26A retromer complex and SNX27 mediate stress-induced Golgi bypass of membrane proteins
task: Identify regulators of Golgi-bypass unconventional protein secretion for CFTR and spike protein
key_results: VPS26A-retromer and SNX27 facilitate ΔF508-CFTR and SARS-CoV-2 spike protein trafficking to cell surface under stress; CRISPR screen identified VPS26A as key contributor
comments: Repurposes known endosomal recycling machinery for unconventional secretion, with therapeutic potential for cystic fibrosis and viral infection.

model_io.model: CRISPR knockout screen in mammalian cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: VPS26A-retromer complex mediates UPS of ΔF508-CFTR
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SNX27 recruits substrate to complex

hypotheses.hypothesis: Retromer components necessary for spike protein UPS
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; required for intact virion assembly

title: Effect of nanoliposomal gamma-oryzanol on cryosurvival, oxidative balance, and fertility of frozen–thawed ram spermatozoa
task: Optimize cryopreservation of ram sperm using nanoliposomal gamma-oryzanol to protect against freeze-thaw damage
key_results: 100 µM gamma-oryzanol nanoparticles (GO-N) increased total motility to 70.45%, progressive motility to 60.21%, plasma membrane integrity to 75.76%, and reduced DNA fragmentation to 17.22%; improved pregnancy rate, lambing rate, and prolificacy
comments: Nanoparticle formulation of antioxidant outperforms free compound, suggesting delivery optimization critical for cryopreservation applications in breeding programs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gamma-oryzanol nanoparticles protect sperm from cryodamage via antioxidant activity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 100 µM GO-N optimal dose for fertility parameters

title: Royal jelly attenuates DMBA induced preneoplastic lesions in rat mammary gland and Skin
task: Evaluate royal jelly's protective effects against DMBA-induced oxidative stress and apoptosis in mammary gland and skin
key_results: Royal jelly co-treatment restored GPx and SOD levels near control, reduced MDA, decreased p53 and Bax, increased Bcl2, and normalized mammary histology while attenuating skin necrosis and epidermal hyperplasia
comments: RJ demonstrates differential tissue-specific efficacy, with complete histological recovery in mammary gland but only partial protection in skin, suggesting tissue-dependent antioxidant mechanisms.

model_io.model: DMBA-induced preneoplastic lesion model in Wistar rats

hypotheses.hypothesis: Royal jelly attenuates DMBA-induced oxidative stress and apoptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in both tissues; stronger effect in mammary gland

title: Pioneering ultrastructural texture analysis of dendrites in the cerebellar dentate nucleus: an experimental rat model of hyperthermia-induced seizures
task: Characterize ultrastructural dendritic damage in hyperthermia-induced seizure model
key_results: Hyperthermic stress induces aponecrotic 'dark dendrite' degeneration in cerebellar dentate nucleus with cytoskeletal disintegration, particularly microtubule loss, correlating with quantitative morphometric analysis
comments: Detailed ultrastructural characterization links dendritic pathology to seizure phenotype, though mechanistic link between microtubule loss and seizure initiation remains to be established.

model_io.model: Transmission electron microscopy of rat cerebellar dentate nucleus

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hyperthermic stress causes aponecrotic dendritic degeneration in dentate nucleus
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; microtubule disintegration prominent

title: Upregulated TRPM1 is associated with apoptosis in Rs1 knockout mice and in ARPE19 cells through increased intracellular calcium
task: Investigate TRPM1 upregulation-mediated retinal apoptosis in X-linked retinoschisis via calcium influx
key_results: TRPM1 expression 1.3-fold higher in Rs1-KO mice and ~2-fold in TRPM1-overexpressing ARPE19 cells; TRPM1-calcium influx promoted CAMKII phosphorylation, P62/LC3B accumulation, increased BAX and decreased BCL2
comments: TRPM1-mediated calcium dysregulation links RS1 deficiency to apoptosis through autophagy and mitochondrial dysfunction, offering a druggable pathway for XLRS therapy.

hypotheses.hypothesis: TRPM1 upregulation in Rs1 deficiency causes calcium-mediated apoptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via CAMKII-autophagy-mitochondrial pathway

title: Hypertonicity-induced RNF183 targets NKCC1 to protect kidney collecting duct cells but induces apoptosis in colon cells
task: Determine RNF183-NKCC1 axis function in hypertonic stress adaptation versus disease
key_results: RNF183 promotes K63-linked ubiquitination and lysosomal degradation of NKCC1; protective in kidney collecting ducts but pro-apoptotic in colon cells with elevated cleaved caspase-3
comments: Tissue-specific context determines whether RNF183 functions protectively or pathologically, with implications for IBD and colorectal cancer mechanisms.

hypotheses.hypothesis: RNF183 targets NKCC1 for degradation under hypertonic stress
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in kidney; opposite effect in colon

title: autoFISH: a modular toolbox for sequential single-molecule RNA FISH experiments
task: Develop affordable automated platform for single-molecule RNA FISH with reduced barriers to adoption
key_results: autoFISH system enables conventional and signal-amplified smFISH with integrated tissue clearing and analysis; validated across multiple cell types and tissue preparations
comments: Open-source hardware and accessible software democratize spatial transcriptomics, though cost and ease trade-offs versus commercial systems warrant direct comparison.

title: Extracellular vesicles derived from senescent hepatocytes drive pan-cancer metastasis in aging
task: Elucidate mechanism by which senescent hepatocyte-derived extracellular vesicles promote pan-cancer metastasis during aging
key_results: Aged liver exhibits elevated P2RX7 expression driving EV biogenesis; EV-encapsulated miRNAs (miR-25, miR-92a, miR-30c, miR-30d) reduce PTEN/LATS2 expression and enhance EMT; targeting senescence (dasatinib+quercetin), P2RX7, or EV-miRNAs reduces metastasis
comments: Aging-driven senescence creates a pro-metastatic microenvironment through circulating EVs, offering multiple druggable targets though therapeutic efficacy in human metastatic disease requires clinical validation.

model_io.model: Aged mouse model of spontaneous/transplanted tumors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Senescent hepatocyte EVs drive metastasis via miRNA-mediated PTEN/LATS2 suppression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; targetable via senescence, P2RX7, or miRNA inhibition

title: CellLoop: Identifying single-cell 3D genome chromatin loops
task: Detect chromatin loops from single-cell 3D genome contact data
key_results: CellLoop improved loop detection consistency with spatial signals; revealed cell-specific loops linked to transcription and cell identity; reduced confounding in developmental studies
comments: Novel density-based voting strategy effectively leverages inter-cellular information to overcome sparsity, but validation limited to two datasets.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrating neighboring cell contacts improves loop detection in sparse single-cell data
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CellLoop outperformed baseline loop detection in mouse brain and embryogenesis data

title: HCCaging: a liver physiological aging-related biomarker for hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis based on transcriptome data
task: Develop liver cancer-specific aging signature (HCCaging) for HCC diagnosis and predict immune microenvironment responses
key_results: HCCaging score higher in normal vs. tumor tissue, early vs. late-stage; increased with chronological age; outperformed 13 prior aging gene sets; elevated T/NK cell effector programs in older patients despite lower infiltration
comments: Sophisticated analysis integrating bulk, single-cell, and clinical data revealing complex dual role of aging in HCC tumorigenesis; translational potential for patient stratification.

model_io.model: HCCaging signature (gradient boosting, random forest classifiers)

hypotheses.hypothesis: HCCaging signature outperforms prior aging gene sets in distinguishing tumor from non-tumor tissue
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; HCCaging-based ML models achieved higher accuracy than 13 alternative aging/senescence gene sets across 8 independent cohorts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aging enhances T/NK cell effector functions but reduces infiltration, creating complex tumor-protective vs. carcinogenic balance
hypotheses.result: Supported; elevated XCL1/XCL2 and cytolytic pathways in older T/NK cells despite reduced overall infiltration

title: Long non-coding RNA profiling of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in mice
task: Profile long non-coding RNA expression changes in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
key_results: RNA-Seq dataset from HCM TNNT2 ∆160 transgenic and WT mice (n=64); differential lncRNA expression delineated; human orthologs identified for translational potential
comments: Valuable resource characterizing lncRNA landscape in HCM model, but primarily a descriptive dataset requiring downstream functional validation.

inputs: left ventricle tissue (31 HCM transgenic, 33 WT mice)

hypotheses.hypothesis: lncRNAs are differentially expressed in HCM and have human orthologs suitable for further study
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; differential lncRNA expression identified; human orthologs determined

title: Benchmarks and methods for 3D medical image retrieval
task: Benchmark 3D medical image retrieval for CT scans
key_results: First 3D-MIR benchmark with four anatomies; Text-to-Image and multi-modal approaches evaluated; quantitative/qualitative assessments provided
comments: Addresses critical gap in evaluation standards but lacks comparison to established 2D retrieval benchmarks for context.

title: Distinct molecular profiles associated with early vs late genome instability in cancer
task: Identify molecular and immune features distinguishing early vs. late genome instability in cancer
key_results: EGI tumors: higher aneuploidy, SBS3 enrichment, activated immune cells (mast/dendritic/NK); LGI tumors: environmental signatures (UV, haloalkanes), resting mast cells; higher stemness in EGI
comments: Novel temporal classification of evolutionary trajectories with clear molecular correlates; findings suggest hallmark ordering influences immunity and plasticity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Timing of genome instability associates with distinct mutational processes and immune states
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; EGI enriched for HR deficiency signatures and activated immune cells; LGI for environmental mutagens and resting immunity

title: Novel deep learning-based optimization framework for the classification of respiratory diseases using lung sound analysis
task: Classify respiratory diseases from lung sounds using deep learning and meta-heuristic optimization
key_results: EBiLSTM-ASBO model achieved 18.51% accuracy improvement over baselines; overall accuracy gains in precision/recall/MCC; p<0.05 statistical significance
comments: Solid deep learning architecture with novel optimizer combination, but evaluation limited to single ICBHI dataset; generalization to other respiratory sound databases unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: EBiLSTM with ASBO optimization surpasses conventional baselines for respiratory disease classification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; up to 18.51% accuracy improvement with statistical significance (p<0.05)

title: Smart medical system integrating clinical workflows for robust skin cancer detection across heterogeneous pathologies
task: Classify skin cancer using hybrid deep learning with attention-guided autoencoder and transformer, optimized via meta-heuristic framework
key_results: Accuracy >98% on HAM10000/ISIC-2019/ISIC-2020; outperformed CNNs, transformers, and hybrid baselines; improved F1-score and AUROC
comments: Ambitious architecture combining multiple advanced techniques (attention, transformer, meta-heuristic optimization) with strong empirical results, but unclear which components drive improvements.

outputs: tuned learning rate, batch size, latent dimensions, attention depth, token resolution

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid architecture with meta-heuristic optimization surpasses state-of-the-art for skin cancer classification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; >98% accuracy and improved F1/AUROC across three benchmark datasets

title: Prediction of primary glaucoma: development and validation of multiple machine learning models
task: Develop and validate machine learning models for primary glaucoma risk prediction using blood markers and retinal parameters
key_results: XGBoost model achieved AUC 0.986 (95% CI 0.974–0.995); 11 predictors identified; SHAP provided interpretability
comments: Strong predictive performance but retrospective design and single-center enrollment limit generalizability; external validation recommended.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrated blood and retinal markers improve glaucoma risk prediction vs. individual modalities
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; XGBoost model with combined features achieved superior performance

title: Machine learning-driven drug repurposing for HER2-positive breast cancer
task: Identify HER2 inhibitors among FDA-approved drugs via machine learning and molecular docking
key_results: Random Forest model (R²=0.81); FDA0870 (Timolol) identified as dual HER2 inhibitor with docking scores -10.5 to -8.0 kcal/mol and stable MD trajectories (RMSD 2.1–3.9 Å)
comments: Comprehensive computational pipeline well-executed, but lacks experimental validation of predicted binding and cellular activity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FDA-approved drugs can be repurposed as HER2 inhibitors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; FDA0870 showed strong predicted binding and MD stability for both WT and mutant HER2

title: Genome-wide identification and expression analysis of HMAs gene family in tobacco under abiotic stress
task: Characterize heavy metal ATPase (HMA) gene family in tobacco under abiotic stress
key_results: Identified 27 NtHMA genes across 6 subfamilies; 10 segmental duplications with Ka/Ks<1 (purifying selection); NtHMA6/14/23 upregulated by heavy metals; others responsive to abiotic stresses
comments: Comprehensive genome-wide analysis with solid phylogenetic/structural support; transcriptomic profiling provides functional hypotheses but functional validation limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: HMA genes show differential stress responsiveness and are under purifying selection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; specific NtHMA genes upregulated by heavy metals/abiotic stresses; all segmental duplicates Ka/Ks<1

title: Impact of chemotherapy exposure on tumor mutation burden in advanced colorectal cancer
task: Examine association between chemotherapy exposure and tumor mutation burden in advanced MSS colorectal cancer
key_results: Prior chemotherapy regimens significantly associated with higher TMB (p<0.05); no association with alcohol/smoking; POLE/POLD1 variants non-pathogenic
comments: Important clinical finding that TMB elevation may reflect treatment effects rather than intrinsic hypermutagenesis, but sample size modest (n=88) and observational design limits causal inference.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chemotherapy exposure increases TMB in MSS CRC independent of baseline mutagenic drivers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; chemotherapy regimens but not POLE/POLD1 variants significantly predicted elevated TMB

title: Fourier transform-based single domain generalization for crowd counting
task: Generalize crowd counting models to unseen domains via frequency-domain alignment
key_results: SinCount achieves competitive performance in single-source domain generalization; frequency-specific feature extraction with dual-attention strategy mitigates domain shift
comments: Fourier-based approach is intuitive but comparison to recent domain generalization methods lacking; ablation studies incomplete.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frequency-domain alignment improves domain generalization for crowd counting
hypotheses.result: Supported; SinCount competitive with state-of-the-art SDG methods across benchmarks

title: Gallbladder removal induces hepatic transcriptional and metabolic shifts with cholesterol dysregulation as a key feature
task: Characterize hepatic transcriptomic and metabolomic changes following cholecystectomy
key_results: Temporal transcriptomic shifts: protein synthesis (day 7) → immune response and cholesterol dysregulation (day 30); 111–125 DEMs identified; cholesterol metabolism most altered pathway
comments: Well-designed temporal multi-omics study revealing metabolic consequences of gallbladder removal; mechanistic insights into cholesterol homeostasis disruption.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cholecystectomy triggers temporal shifts in liver transcriptome from protein synthesis to immune/metabolic remodeling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; distinct pathway activation patterns at days 7 and 30 with cholesterol dysregulation as key feature

title: Efferocytosis-related gene PLG in prognosis, immune correlation, and contribution to malignant behavior in vitro and in vivo of clear cell renal cell carcinoma
task: Identify efferocytosis genes predictive of ccRCC prognosis and PLG's role in immune regulation
key_results: Six-gene risk model stratified patients with significant survival difference; PLG overexpression reduced proliferation/migration and enhanced CD8+ T cell cytotoxicity
comments: Strong integration of bulk genomics with functional validation, though causality remains to be definitively established for all pathway components.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ERG-based risk score predicts survival independent of other factors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; risk score remained independent predictor in multivariate analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: PLG suppresses ccRCC malignant behavior and enhances anti-tumor immunity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PLG overexpression inhibited proliferation/migration and enhanced CD8+ cytotoxicity

title: Physics-informed graph neural networks for real-time prediction of wall shear stress in stenotic coronary arteries
task: Predict wall shear stress in stenotic coronary arteries via physics-informed graph neural networks
key_results: PI-GNN achieved MAE 1.05 Pa, RMSE 5.63 Pa, R=0.94; outperformed U-Net (R=0.85) and MLP (R=0.24); inference in seconds vs. hours for CFD
comments: Physics-informed approach elegantly constrains GNN learning; excellent generalization across stenosis morphologies but validation limited to synthetic variations from 40 subjects.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics-informed GNN surpasses conventional models (U-Net, MLP) for hemodynamic prediction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PI-GNN achieved R=0.94 vs. U-Net R=0.85 and MLP R=0.24

title: Identification of NF-κB pathway-related biomarkers in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury: based on transcriptomics analysis and RT-qPCR validation
task: Identify NF-κB pathway biomarkers in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury via transcriptomics and ceRNA networks
key_results: Nfkbia and Icam1 identified as key biomarkers; TLCK predicted as dual inhibitor; constructed ceRNA network with mmu-miR-706 and 7 lncRNAs; RT-qPCR validation confirmed upregulation
comments: Comprehensive bioinformatic pipeline with experimental validation, but functional studies remain preliminary; causal roles of lncRNAs/miRNAs require further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: NF-κB pathway genes predict MIRI outcomes and form regulatory networks involving lncRNAs
hypotheses.result: Supported; Nfkbia/Icam1 upregulated in MIRI; ceRNA network constructed; TLCK identified as candidate drug

title: A Multimodal Acousto-Optic Dataset for Underwater Image Enhancement, Detection, and Reconstruction
task: Multimodal underwater image enhancement and object detection dataset creation

Dataset supports training for multiple underwater perception tasks with guaranteed kinematic parameter accuracy

title: Intelligent performance prediction of nanoparticle-enhanced automotive radiator cooling using CFD and machine learning

title: Structural equation modeling approach to evaluate effects of socio-economic and built environment factors on trip generation rates of commercial land use

title: AB jailbreaking - a novel hybrid framework for exploitation of adversarial vulnerabilities in LLMs

Heterogeneous weighted mean field model effectively addressed coupling in heterogeneous agents; dynamic adaptive framework enhanced environmental robustness
